---
title: "Lightbox: automatic mode"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/example.qmd (minus the R
# cells; see cell-options.qmd). `lightbox: auto` wraps every figure and
# every image alone in its paragraph; inline images need the explicit
# class; `.nolightbox` opts out; images already inside a link are skipped.
lightbox: auto
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'script[src$="glightbox/glightbox.min.js"]'
          - 'figure a.lightbox[title="Beach in Chilmark"] > img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox[data-gallery="elsewhere"] > img[src="images/mv-1.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox[data-gallery="elsewhere"] > img[src="images/mv-2.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox[data-gallery="elsewhere"] > img[src="images/mv-3.png"]'
          - 'p > a.lightbox[data-gallery="quarto-lightbox-gallery-5"] > img[src="images/chunky.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox[title="A chunky image"] > img[src="images/cool.png"][width="30"]'
          - 'a[href="https://example.com/ferry"] > img[src="images/ferry.png"]'
          - 'img.nolightbox[src="images/mv-2.png"]'
        - - 'a.lightbox > img[src="images/ferry.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox > img.nolightbox'
          - 'a.lightbox > img[src="images/mv-3.png"][width="31"]'
---

## Inline images are ignored

This image ![So cool](images/mv-3.png){width=31} is inline, so automatic
mode skips it. This one ![A chunky image](images/cool.png){.lightbox width=30}
carries the explicit class, so it is wrapped.
